entities.name: King Saul
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: First king of the united kingdom of Israel (c. 1050–1010 BCE), anointed by Samuel. Initially successful in battle against the Philistines, Saul's reign was marked by increasing disobedience, jealousy of David, and mental anguish, ending in his death at the Battle of Gilboa.
